# goslop text fixture — resource close alone is not an assertion (movielite
# clip.close() benchmark shape must keep firing).
lang: python
file: benchmarks/compare_moviepy.py
---
def test_no_processing_movielite(input_path: str, output_path: str):
    clip = ml.VideoClip(input_path)
    writer = ml.VideoWriter(output_path, fps=clip.fps)
    writer.add_clip(clip)
    writer.write()
    clip.close()
